hypothetical_extrapolation.assumption: One equally sized 120-reference audit per month; not a selected schedule, not representative future survival/content size, excludes raw GKG acquisition and backups.

measurement: Actual UTF-8 on-disk artifact bytes; file sets explicit, excludes Git history, code/docs, tests and backup copies.

retention.irreplaceable: Preregistration, sample, retrieval receipts/minimal excerpts, human annotations when supplied, reviewer attestations and trust roots. Preserve original quarantine and 96-batch corpus.
retention.normally_retained: Assessments, packets, compact context cache, derived records.
retention.replaceable_public_artifacts: Ordinary future GKG archives only under separately configurable retention; no deletion implemented. Public article bodies are transient, with hash and exact revision limitations documented.
